title: The Fact and Opinion Ferry
learning_focus: Fact/opinion/fact-based opinion, explanation, recount, news report, evidence, drawing conclusions, and generalizations.
story_premise: A ferry guide mixes historical facts, personal memories, and advertisements in one narration. Passengers cannot tell what is verified.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Fact/opinion/fact-based opinion, explanation, recount, news report, evidence, drawing conclusions, and generalizations.

areas.title: Ticket Booth
areas.story: Classify statements by type. Arrange a chronological account from supplied evidence.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Mission Guide
opening_dialogue.text: The Haze has damaged the work in Ticket Booth.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Mission Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe the clues, use Fact/opinion/fact-based opinion, explanation, recount, news report, evidence, drawing conclusions, and generalizations, and repair this area before collecting the Story Fragment.

learning_clues: Learning focus: Fact/opinion/fact-based opinion, explanation, recount, news report, evidence, drawing conclusions, and generalizations.
Use details from the text, dialogue, and visual layout as evidence.
